acceptance.expected: Reviewer verifies remaining api section edits against cited sources: R1 uses docker compose up -d api to apply changed Compose environment/env_file and needs neither restart nor recreate for checks-file reload; R2/F2 apply maintenance and removed-check changes at start, reload and admin write; R3 removed heartbeat check loses its secret; R4 distinguishes protected GETs. W1 states admin AND checks authority reaches secrets only on bound hosts, env storage does not remove that authority, and probe tokens read literal headers/bodies (not probe env values). W2 keeps retries limited to HTTP GET/HEAD (including omitted method), TCP/DNS/domain, judged before redirects; other HTTP methods get no retry and make one attempt per run on each probe location. Side effects may repeat across runs, locations and followed redirects; an attempt can also send no request (header denial reports attempts: 1; an already-aborted run sends nothing), and a connection can fail before the target acts. Never promise the target is reached at least once. An attempt can make multiple requests: 307/308 preserves method/body; src/check.redirect.test.ts:112-124 expects two POSTs in one attempt. The retries and method rows link to probe configuration.md#retries and recommend side-effect-free endpoints; they never promise one request per run or once per interval. POST /results idempotence and notify delivery do not protect the checked request. Probe locations notes unsent in-memory results lost on probe restart. Sources: src/start.ts reload onApply, src/service.ts:upsertChecks, src/token-scopes.ts:canUse, probe src/client.ts:resolveHeaders, src/header-hosts.ts:isBound, src/check.ts:isRetryable, src/check.ts:111-127/158-159, src/check.ts:410/462-549, src/check.redirect.test.ts:112-124 and src/buffer.ts.

Reviewer verifies every added/changed relative link resolves to an existing file and heading, including probe operation.md#result-buffer and configuration.md#retries; preserves all api anchors listed in Non-goals. Full bun run check includes src/docs-claims.test.ts and src/tokens.test.ts without edits; existing backup/token/auth doc assertions remain.

PR body contains the Required behavior evidence table for F1-F4, R1-R4 and W1-W5 plus the Probe locations buffer note: item, file/section, old text or missing, new statement and source file/symbol at the checked commit. F3 is explicitly already satisfied. For W2 cite probe src/check.ts:isRetryable, src/check.ts:111-127 and :158-159 (attempts without any request), src/check.ts:410/462-549 and src/check.redirect.test.ts:112-124 (two POSTs in one attempt). Includes N1-N9 outputs, P1-P6 review evidence, bun run check result, Markdown-only changed-file list and resolved-link review. Security guidance is checked against W1-W5 sources; no performance A/B run is required by the spec.
